paragraphs: POSTCARDS FROM DAINYEL Take the scenic route.
Which of these would you put on a postcard? 🥾
Some photographs deserve more than a quick scroll.
Green terraces above a mountain valley. Stone paths disappearing into the greenery. Machu Picchu beneath low clouds.
I’ve brought these moments together in my Peru photo notebook , with separate galleries for the Inca Trail and Machu Picchu.
If you read The Inca Trail Is No Joke , think of this as its visual companion: more photographs from the journey, ready to explore at your own pace.
And now I’m curious: which photograph would you choose for a real postcard?
Hit reply and describe your favourite. The big mountain view—or one of the little details along the way?
See you on the scenic route, Dainyel
